name: Seaboard Foods of Iowa LLC
old_description: We celebrate America through our commitment to excellence—producing some of the world’s best pork and feeding people around the globe.
about:
Seaboard Foods of Iowa LLC operates from Iowa Falls, Iowa, where it has maintained a large-scale pork processing facility since the early 1990s. The company is American-owned, though the INPUT does not specify a founding year, individual founders, or a more precise ownership structure such as family or employee ownership.

The business centers on a vertically integrated pork production system the company calls The Prairie Fresh Way, linking farm operations, feed milling, pork processing, transportation, and renewable natural gas production. The website describes its Iowa Falls plant as one of the newest and largest in the industry, but it does not disclose facility size, headcount, annual volumes, or part numbers.

Seaboard Foods serves the food and agriculture sectors, supplying pork products to domestic and global customers. The INPUT mentions community partnerships such as Operation BBQ Relief, scholarship programs, and teacher grants as examples of its customer and community engagement, but it does not name specific commercial clients or industry verticals beyond general pork production.

The company states that its differentiation lies in a "uniquely connected food system" spanning from before the farm to the table, underpinned by commitments to employees, animal care, food safety and quality, customers, the environment, and local communities. No further technical or operational differentiators are provided in the source material.
